title: A Member's Patronage on Feed Tons, the Per-Unit Retain and the Feed Statement
content:
Members buying feed from their own cooperative should know which of the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes earn patronage allocation on the tons bought, how much capital is retained on each ton and credited to the member's equity account, and by what channel the feed statement reaches them.

| Programme | Tons bought earn patronage allocation | Capital retained per ton and credited to equity | How the feed statement reaches the member |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | no | $0.0000 | a printout handed over at the counter |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | yes | $0.1500 | a mailed statement |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | yes | $0.1500 | a mailed statement |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | yes | $0.1500 | the member portal and email |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | yes | $0.1500 | the member portal and email |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | yes | $0.1500 | the member portal and email |

Five of the six programmes earn patronage on the tons bought, the Bagged Feed Cash Account alone standing outside it, and every one of those five retains the same fifteen hundredths of a dollar on each ton for the member's equity account. Statements reach the member at the counter on the Bagged Feed Cash Account, by post on the Bulk Delivered Feed Account and the Custom Mix Ration Program, and through the portal and by email on the Contracted Ingredient Program, the Full Nutrition Partner Program and the Medicated Feed VFD Program.

*Hypothetical.* Two hundred tons taken in a year on a Custom Mix Ration Program retain fifteen hundredths of a dollar a ton, which is thirty dollars credited to the member's equity account; the same two hundred tons taken on a Bagged Feed Cash Account retain nothing, since the figure standing against that programme is nought.
